name: Eric H. Holder, Jr.
subject: 60 years from Bloody Sunday, our march is not yet finished
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
I hope you’ll help honor their legacy by continuing their unfinished work with the same determination and hope.
|
---

Peter,
This month, as we mark 60 years since Bloody Sunday, we're reminded that, as Dr. King said, the arc of the moral universe is long — but it bends towards justice.
**What we need to understand is that the arc doesn't bend on its own.**
It’s the dedication of all those brave men and women, seemingly ordinary but all extraordinary — who throughout history have risked, and too often given, their lives in order that others might live free.
In the first days of March 1965, hundreds of peaceful activists, protesting to secure the right to vote, set out from Selma along the road to Montgomery. They made it as far as the foot of the Edmund Pettus Bridge before they were met with terrible violence at the hands of state and local law enforcement.
**The events of this day not only steeled the resolve of America’s civil rights leaders — it compelled our national policymakers to take action.**
With the passage of the landmark Voting Rights Act of 1965, our country finally created a robust safeguard for preventing discrimination and disenfranchisement in our elections. We finally had strong tools in place to deliver on the promise of fair representation for all voters, with fair district lines that would give communities the opportunity to elect the candidates of their choice.
But ever since the Voting Rights Act was enacted, anti-democracy forces have sought to weaken it — in a continued, concerted effort to achieve unearned, illegitimate power at the expense of people of color.
**60 years from Bloody Sunday, our march is not yet finished.** The U.S. Supreme Court is now set to rule in a Louisiana redistricting case that could overturn a key portion of that landmark law.
While we likely won't know how the justices rule until June, we cannot stop working to protect our democracy and fight for fair maps. We cannot afford to give in to cynicism and doubt. We cannot be fatigued, overwhelmed, or indifferent.
Our heroes of the civil rights movement showed us what courage looks like in the face of seemingly insurmountable odds. We must honor their legacy by continuing their unfinished work with the same determination and hope.
In this moment of maximum danger to our country, it is now time for all those who love America most dearly to stand up and speak out for the principles that, at our best, define the nation. We have a sacred charge to uphold the legacy of those who gave their lives so that we may all have the right to vote.
**It’s why All On The Line is leading the march towards a higher ideal — an ideal where every voter is empowered, transparency is non-negotiable, and electoral maps accurately reflect the will of the people.**
Together, we hold leaders accountable, tirelessly advocate for fair maps across the nation, and unwaveringly uphold the core principles of democracy reform and election integrity.
With your support, we’re preparing to stop potential efforts by partisan actors to steal more congressional seats through extreme gerrymandering. We’re working to ensure an accurate count in the next census that leads to fair maps for the next decade. And we’re standing alongside voters as they demand the fair representation that is their birthright.
[**I’m grateful that you’ve helped make this ongoing work possible, and I hope you’ll help continue fighting for our democracy alongside All On The Line.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104704373/536210299/-766669867?refcode=don_aotl_tier1_email_AGEOQ1_email_20250328-AOTL-Tier1-AGEOQ1-EHH_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250328-AOTL-Tier1-AGEOQ1-EHH_&utm_campaign=AGEOQ1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjEwNGZkYjNkLTBmMGMtZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=A0DWEx-lcSiSl0XFaRvSjC_X9N0BAGVExE-6w6xPL3o=)

body:

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stupb8&__onlt=t

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dk98urj22fxm2pzar9ih9nyr4f7lvgc6fpo7tnlmjjzumm47htu872s0nbff3a5st88y7i2sbpwa6rf1jgnnlx4g6peqfl9tkyr98lb24qqg92vncjy7h0m7u0w7wskygbjxrlwcvezq0w6hq5bo&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stupb8&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stupb8&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stupb8&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stupb8&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dk98urj22fxm2pzar9ih9nyrqsmrdya1xmvz6uok4m9p4wg5xb5qpxiuu8juw9wup5mk8rune1qluvuiclr7y7qwhmxpcjwthpm43tbasgsow08uegbgtlit6jg51mu76lyk8s7cqgp3u9m6ng50&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stupb8&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stupb8&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:

#
---
_Aloha Peter, this is Mazie. Please read the below message from my friend Senator Cory Booker. _ Peter — throughout my career in politics, I’ve had one guiding principle: **Love.** Love is the reason why, as a first-time candidate running for Newark City Council, I went on a hunger strike to draw attention to the desperation facing the most vulnerable communities in our city. Love motivated me to run for mayor, and after coming up short the first time, love motivated me to get back up and try again. Love is what has carried me through days when it feels like the forces of chaos and division keep our nation inescapably focused on destructive acts of hate. There’s no such thing as too much love, Peter. It’s the driving force that keeps folks safe, gives us hope when we have none, and inspires us to create the America we know is possible. And love is what drives Senate Democrats to fight for affordable housing, to help working Americans keep more of their hard-earned paycheck, to lower the cost of child care and groceries, and so much more. Peter, Mazie and I will work with anyone who wants to make life better for folks like you. But if Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and Senate Republicans do things to hurt you — like coming after affordable health care, pursuing policies that drive up costs, and paying for tax cuts for the wealthy by coming after your hard-earned benefits — **we will fight.** **[We are united, determined, and ready to fight for working Americans. Hey Peter, I hope that you are planning a nice weekend. I’m looking forward to a great weekend out in the Quad Cities. There’s nothing like time back home to help with perspective. Like you, I’ve felt a LOT of feelings since November: anger, frustration, fear, confusion, and even despair. It hasn’t always been fun. There are people in our country that are losing jobs, rights, benefits, and their sense of wellbeing. When I think about it, I’m consistently left with one thought: **It's time to go where the fight is.** I’m done waiting for some national, Democratic figure to swoop in with a message to save us... _we know what to talk about._ I’m done listening to anyone who isn’t ready to show empathy and fight for those who are really hurting... _we know better._ We need to be smart, and stand up where we can make a difference, but we have to go where the fight is. **And the fight is in each and every one of our communities. It’s the Wisconsin Supreme Court race, the school board meeting, the canned food drive, the Habitat for Humanity homebuilding project, and yes, the fight for Congress.** I’m going neighbor by neighbor, hometown by hometown to make sure that we are in the fight. Oh, and when it happens, I’ll be right there – to vote against and speak out against – whatever nonsense the other side comes up with. [**I hope you’ll stay with me in this fight. You can RSVP and learn more at the links attached. Karen has also set up an open application process for Democrats around our state to apply to be Deputy Chairs for our Party. Karen is determined to make sure our party welcomes all voices and that new people are given the opportunity to succeed. She also called most of our County Chairs this week. She had a goal to call every one of the County Chairs, and while she fell a bit short this week of reaching them all, she will be reaching out to even more of them next week. Karen has also spent the last two weeks building relationships with elected officials and other leaders across the state, including attending fundraisers and building a stronger network for our Party. Where in the World is Diego Morales? This Time He’s in India, Not Indiana After going missing from the public for 10 days, Diego Morales publicly posted that he is India. Ed DeLaney and proposed an amendment to cut any budget increases for his office, which was voted down by Statehouse Republicans. Team,
Donald Trump is daring Congress to stop him as he destroys U.S. institutions and good programs that exist to protect consumers and working people.
They won't. The MAGA-controlled House is fully on board with Trump's Project 2025 Agenda. They are actively enabling Trump's abuse of power and Musk's rampage across the many programs that working Americans rely on -- especially now, with inflation and rising costs made worse by Trump's senseless trade wars.
But MAGA didn't expect us. That was a critical mistake for which we are making them pay, badly.
Now that they see us gathering our strength and fighting back, they are mobilizing. Recognizing they are at risk of losing the race here in Florida's 6th District, Trump yanked his nomination of Elise Stefanik to the United Nations to keep her in her seat in Congress in case they lose on Tuesday.
They are worried, and they know that their lackluster candidate here is like an anchor around their necks weighing them down.
This election is our only chance to stop Project 2025 in its tracks before the damage is too deep to undo.
Your support will determine whether we run the strongest, most unified campaign against MAGA ever--or if we falter in the final hours just inches from the finish line.
MAGA isn't giving up. And neither can we.
Let's make this our finest hour. [This is our moment, friends. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Less than one month after ICE agents arrested, detained, and threatened to
deport Palestinian activist and Columbia University graduate Mahmoud
Khalil for protesting the genocide in Gaza, they did it again.

This week, plain clothes agents kidnapped Tufts University PhD student
Runeysa Ozturk off the streets, put her in an unmarked vehicle, and then
transported her to an ICE detention center in Louisiana.

Just like with Mahmoud, there are no criminal charges filed against
Runeysa: Trump’s Secretary of State Marco Rubio says they revoked her visa
and plan on deporting her to Turkey for her pro-Palestinian activism. In
other words, for writing an op-ed in the college newspaper criticizing her
university’s response to pro-Palestinian student activism.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/em-20250328-free-rumeysa-ozturk/?source=em20250328-36541&akid=36541%2E1203867%2Eq759cF ]A tweet from Prem Thakker which reads "So the position of the
Trump-Vance administration - and every member of Congress unless they
explicitly say otherwise - is quite literally you do not have guaranteed
free speech rights in America if you say things they don't like. That is
the headline. Thakker is quoting a tweet from CSPAN which says "@SecRubio
on detained Turkish Student: "We revoked her visa...We gave you a visa to
come and study and get a degree not to become a social activist that tears
up our university campuses. if we've given you a visa and then you decide
to do that we're going to take it away.""

Rubio claimed he’s now revoked more than 300 visas from international
students and threatened to do it again and again.

Fascism is here, Peter. Under
this administration, there is no freedom of speech. If Trump’s
administration can deploy their American Gestapo to criminalize, round up,
and deport these innocent students for their political viewpoints, they
can do it to any of us.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/em-20250328-free-rumeysa-ozturk/?source=em20250328-36541&akid=36541%2E1203867%2Eq759cF ]Fight back NOW: Add your name to our petition demanding the immediate
release of Rumeysa Ozturk and an end to these attacks on free speech.

U.S. Senator Katie Britt joined U.S. Rep. Kat Cammack of Florida at the White House on Tuesday to announce the formation of the Republican Women’s Caucus, positioning Alabama’s junior senator in a leading role on a new initiative aimed at uniting Republican women in Congress. The pair unveiled the caucus on Tuesday during a high-profile White House event with President Donald Trump.

Britt, Alabama’s first elected female senator and the youngest Republican woman ever elected to the Senate, said the caucus will focus on promoting common-sense and conservative values that resonate with families across Alabama and the nation.

U.S. Sen. Katie Britt, R-Ala., recently introduced the bipartisan She Develops Regulations In Vehicle Equality and Safety (She DRIVES) Act to raise vehicle crash testing standards and improve passenger vehicle safety. According to Britt’s official press release, the legislation “would modernize vehicle safety tests by requiring the use of the most advanced testing devices available—including a female crash test dummy.”

“It is past time for crash testing to reflect the full range of drivers and passengers on the road. By updating standards to include female crash test dummies, we can make cars safer for everyone and better protect our loved ones,” Britt said in an official statement. “I’m proud to join my colleagues on this commonsense legislation that will truly save lives.”

Despite their conflicting college team loyalties, U.S. Sens. Tommy Tuberville and Katie Britt applauded Auburn University head basketball coach Bruce Pearl after he commended Trump's efforts in the Middle East.

Pearl has been a vocal supporter of Israel since the nation was attacked on Oct. 7, 2023, when Hamas terrorists killed and kidnapped hundreds of Israelis.

Since then, Alabama's state and federal leaders have expressed unequivocal support for Israel in its continued fight against Hamas and its supporters.

Beto and I held an incredible town hall in Houston, and let me tell you, the energy in that room was unstoppable.
Trump and his MAGA loyalists are tearing through our country. Meanwhile, Elon Musk is nonsensically gutting critical systems that families and working people rely on just to get by – because he thinks his billions put him above the rest of us.

subject: This is no joke

body:
Every single day counts in the fight ahead.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20250328-1&t=1&akid=1911%2E587540%2EJvj12E)
Peter, it is fucking infuriating to watch the Trump administration wreak havoc on our government and enact their dangerous, destructive agenda.
We need to be taking pages out of Mitch McConnell’s playbook that he used for years to stop Obama, to stop Biden, and prevent Democrats from passing our agenda. Everything has to be on the table to stop and slow Trump.
On top of that, we need to be organizing against vulnerable Republicans and turning the screws on them. We have to make their lives as painful as possible and line up the incentives for them to oppose Trump.
And finally we have to look ahead to upcoming elections and get behind people that are filled with rage over Trump’s actions and have a burning fire within them to stop Trump and fight aggressively for a vision of this country that allows us to have more affordable housing, better healthcare, and provides some real economic opportunity and security.
That’s where we come in.
**And** **that’s why I’m setting a $100,000 goal to show the power of our movement before the end-of-quarter fundraising deadline.**
**[Can you pitch in $5 to help reach our goal and power our mission to elect the next generation of leaders?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20250328-1?refcode=em20250328-1911&amount=5&refcode2=1911_587540_Jvj12E&akid=1911%2E587540%2EJvj12E)**
This is no joke. _Every single day counts in the fight ahead._ If we fall short of this goal, we’ll be at a serious disadvantage going into the critical battles to come.
**Here’s the truth:** The GOP is already gearing up for the next fight. If we don’t keep our fundraising on track, the billionaires and corporate elite will keep pouring money into the Republican right-wing agenda while Democrats and progressives are left scrambling.
**But we’re not going to let that happen.** We may not have the special interests on our side, but I know that the grassroots can be even more powerful.
This goal is bigger than just hitting a fundraising target. It’s about empowering real leadership and political progress.
**We need leaders who fight for working families, voting rights, and climate justice. Leaders who will not back down when things get tough.**
That’s exactly why Leaders We Deserve exists. Now, we need your help to make sure we can keep electing the young, progressive leaders we deserve.
**[Peter, we need your support to hit our $100K goal before the big deadline on March 31. Can you chip in $5 toward our goal and help power our game-changing work?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20250328-1?refcode=em20250328-1911&amount=5&refcode2=1911_587540_Jvj12E&akid=1911%2E587540%2EJvj12E)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20250328-1?amount=5&refcode=em20250328-1911&refcode2=1911_587540_Jvj12E&akid=1911%2E587540%2EJvj12E)**
Thank you for being part of this movement.
David Hogg
Leaders We Deserve

**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-footer?refcode=em20250328-1&t=2&refcode2=1911_587540_Jvj12E&akid=1911%2E587540%2EJvj12E)**

Ballooning Medicaid costs, TABOR limits expose flaws in Colorado’s big government spending spree
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-cqLg/s1i2e02c96c)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-cqLg/sfj4bc860f6)**
| | Hi folks,
Tomorrow’s vote for the next Colorado GOP Chair is a pivotal moment for the future of our party—and grassroots conservatives across the state are watching closely. If you're a part of the Central Committee, I encourage you to read our [latest coverage](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-cqLg/sfmd42bf09f) at Rocky Mountain Voice before the ballots are cast, including [my new commentary](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-cqLg/s0keedc6ac9). You can also listen to the last two episodes of [Unleashed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-cqLg/sap12b85448) for my personal take on the race!
Let’s make sure the next leader of the Colorado GOP represents the will of the people—not the political elite.
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, March 28, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Ballooning Medicaid costs, TABOR limits expose flaws in Colorado’s big government spending spree](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-cqLg/sftb518e344)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE EDITORIAL BOARD](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-cqLg/s2m432353bc)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-cqLg/s0m29f45b6f)
After years of overreach and unchecked government growth, Colorado lawmakers are now scrambling to plug a $1.2 billion hole in the state budget — a crisis largely of their own making.

Colorado budget writers voted Wednesday night to finalize a 2025–26 budget plan that slashes transportation funding, eliminates programs, and kicks key decisions down the road — all while Medicaid spending surges out of control.

Despite the so-called “cuts,” the budget still grows to over $16 billion. But massive increases in Medicaid — particularly long-term care for seniors and the disabled — are eating up the budget at an unsustainable pace. Democrat lawmakers admit the problem is only getting worse. “Next year, I see our fiscal challenges compounding,” said Rep. Shannon Bird, vice chair of the Joint Budget Committee (JBC), during a hearing.

Conservatives argue this crisis is a direct result of failed progressive governance: endless new programs, expensive mandates, and refusal to address structural overspending.

More than ever before, we need to be prepared for whatever comes next. When our fundraising numbers go public, everyone— Republican operatives, the media, and potential challengers —will be looking for signs of weakness. We cannot afford to fall short and give them any reason to think this seat is flippable. That's why my team and I set an ambitious online fundraising goal to reach before then. name: Miracle in FL-06
subject: Politico: Race is much closer than people expected, GOP worried
body:
A damning article for the FL GOP just came out in POLITICO yesterday, and within it is the crux of our entire fight here in Florida’s 6th District.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-weil?refcode=250328em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-weil?refcode=250328em]
If you only take away ONE thing from the article—I will explain why—make it this: as POLITICO says, “President Donald Trump handpicked state Sen. Randy Fine” to succeed Waltz, who he tapped as National Security Adviser.
Trump arrogantly picked a GOP House member for his administration, reducing their already-razor-thin majority—and on top of that, he selected an absolutely bonkers MAGA lunatic with personal baggage and no ability to connect with voters. In short, he picked a terrible candidate.
And now, we’re pouncing on this historic blunder.
The race being this close is already a disaster for MAGA and Trump. As we press our advantage and run even harder, faster, and stronger in this crucial final stretch, our objective is near in sight: delivering a massive defeat and embarrassment for Donald Trump that he will be personally responsible for in his First 100 Days.
Can you imagine it? Consider how brutal April 2 will be for Trump when we pull off this upset and elect Josh Weil, a humble public school teacher, and defeat DONALD TRUMP’S HANDPICKED CANDIDATE!
They are still underestimating us, even now. They are expecting us to slow our pace, to mess up, or for Democrats to turn on each other instead of focusing on beating them. Well, we won’t give up, and we won’t stop.
But we need your continued support, or it could end up being us that are embarrassed on Election Day.
Will you please chip in $25, $50, or whatever you can do right now, split with Tobias Read, to twist the knife in the final days and hours of this special election? Let's get to work,
Team Weil

body:
# [](https://act.robbonta.com/go/3?refcode=em20250328&t=1&akid=1714%2E1088799%2ESaB-i9)
We know it’s probably getting hard to keep up with all of the unlawful and harmful actions President Donald Trump and his MAGA administration are taking against our Constitution and our communities.
That’s part of the problem: they’re _flooding the zone and trying to keep us overwhelmed._ But don’t worry: Rob is on top of it.
This week alone, Rob took the following legal actions against this administration’s attempt to roll back our rights and hurt California families:
* Sought a court order to **block the mass firing of U.S. Department of Education employees and the attempt to dismantle this critical federal agency** that supports our children’s K-12 education, student aid, services for students with disabilities, civil rights enforcement, vocational training, and more.

* Led a coalition of 23 attorneys general asking the courts to enforce an order requiring the Trump administration to **unfreeze millions of dollars in FEMA funding for critical emergency preparedness and disaster relief.**

* Filed an amicus brief supporting a **challenge to the administration’s plan to terminate the Temporary Protected Status (TPS) designation for Haitians and Venezuelans** , which would strip more than 50% of all TPS holders of legal protections that allow them to live lawfully in the U.S. after escaping dangerous conditions in their home countries.

Rob has also spoken out against the Trump administration’s potential rollback of abortion care for veterans and their families, and opposed the President’s illegal executive order that could make voting in our elections more difficult.
As long as Rob is California’s Attorney General, he will not give up or sit back while Trump, his cabinet, or anyone else attacks our freedoms and defies the rule of law.
**But there’s more work to do than hours in a day, so Rob has less time than ever before to think about fundraising.[Can he count on you to give a grassroots donation of $5 or more to ensure we reach our end-of-quarter goal before March ends? ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250328?refcode=em20250328-1714&amount=5&refcode2=1714_1088799_SaB-i9&akid=1714%2E1088799%2ESaB-i9)**

Thanks for having Rob’s back while he has ours!
— Bonta HQ

body:

Friend – the latest poll in **FL-6** just dropped, and I am locked in a dead heat with my radical leftist opponent **inside the******margin of error****.
We are staring down the barrel of a loss that could rip Congress apart and unleash chaos.
The other side smells blood in the water, and they’re pouring in **_millions of dollars_** to buy this race... And if the latest poll is any indication, **their strategy might be working**.

This isn’t about politics as usual, it’s about saving the House of Representatives from descending into chaos. Your donation today isn’t just a contribution, it could be the difference between victory and a defeat that could haunt us for years if we fail.

[CLOSE THE GAP](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/afzo/?__vbtrk=MjgyODQ2OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjgyODQ2OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
